text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Per Symboli Rudolf's request, we went to pay a visit to the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...It's quiet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Purification of the six roots of perception...
Indeed, taking in the air here makes me feel cleansed from within.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting every day. Constantly pursuing the best path.
While those certainly drive us forward—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In the daily struggle of marching forward, one's body is bound to get dirty,
and fatigue will surely cloud one's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe that reaching this state of complete emptiness from time to time
is an essential ritual for returning to one's origins.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And—there I go talking about stiff, formal things again.
It's a bad habit of mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: More importantly, shall we head over to pay our respects?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, truly a breath of cool, refreshing air!
I feel so invigorated. My body feels lighter somehow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides—perhaps clearing my mind helped,
because a solution to the academy's dilemma just came to me...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let's head back to the academy right away, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf seems in great shape.
Her shrine visit must have paid off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, Symboli Rudolf and I
clasped our hands together, but—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late~!
A kid got lost at the station, you see...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're way too soft-hearted!
You're hopeless~

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It can't be helped... wait, ginger...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ginger... wait, ginger...!
I get it, shrine and ginger...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
This is quite the masterpiece...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gaaah, gaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was suddenly attacked by a crow!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, are you unharmed!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see, that's the best news of all...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And yet... this is troublesome.
It feels as though I have been scolded through a crow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Getting distracted and laughing at a shrine while offering prayers
was truly disrespectful of me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: All I can do is deeply reflect on my actions...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It turned out to be an ominous start...
